title: Charlie Christian
summary: Greer calls Charlie Christian beautiful and level-headed but says they weren't close.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: What did you think of Charlie Christian? Did you meet him?
Oh, I've heard with him many times. Charlie Christian -- guitar player?
Beautiful. The end. The last word. Charlie Christian was a famous guitarist. Beautiful. They still talking about him. And he's been dead a long time.
Did you and him ever hang out together?

Uh-uh. We wasn't close because our paths didn't cross that much. But I knew him. Whenever he played we would go hear him. But we were what you call moving fast. And he was different things but accidentally we'd
cross each other and we'd sit and talk about New York, have some fun. But that's all.
What kind of a guy did he strike you as?
He strike me as a beautiful person. Very congenial, lovely. His success never went to his head, he was just a level guy. Everybody loved the cat. He was beautiful.
